node.title: Rate-half FPC5 M=4,t=2 guarded split-locator payment
node.statement: For the official rate-half row, fix one admissible maximal M=4 sunflower source. Aggregate every non-planted FPC5 contributor touching exactly two full petals by one internal tangent, quotient/profile, or polynomial first owner. General first-layout domination proves that this one-layout payment plus at most four anchors is already global over source layouts. Every fixed exact-background guarded cell now has locator codimension at least ell-1, with equality on r=s and codimension at least ell for r>=s+1. Without selecting the uniquely reconstructed background set, the complete fixed-s residual is one joint locus where F splits on the source core and W_F has at least s background roots. Primitive cofactor determinants bound combined core/background overlap by 2s and give one aggregate packing, but a sharp Gilbert fence constructs exponentially large abstract families satisfying the same block, weight, and distance data. At the sharp endpoint the actual flat has common gcd one and no proper pure multiplicative quotient pullbacks. The remaining content is algebraic root-rich split-pair control beyond support distance, including possible partial-tail/rational/dihedral structures and internal-owner multiplicity.
node.attack_surface: use the guarded cofactor flat, smooth-domain incidence, or received-word ownership to improve the root-rich split-pair count beyond the proved distance-only no-go fence
node.falsifier: a fixed official rate-half source whose internally first-owned two-full-petal contributors exceed every polynomial and legitimate profile column
